ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution shows a low ratio of high-intensity pixels (estimated <5%) concentrated at tips to low-intensity pixels (>95%) across the majority of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous low-intensity (black) region across both lobes. Distinct, high-contrast irregular white pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 80-90 degree aperture and a pixel depth significant relative to the central fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations along the trailing edge with pixel-level amplitude increasing towards the distal tips; peaks and valleys are clearly delineated against the lower-intensity background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory initiating at the median notch, transitioning to a steep upward convex sweep toward the lobe extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular clusters of high-intensity white pixels localized at the distal tips of both lobes, suggesting calcified surface attachments.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical parallel light-grey linear disruptions visible in the lower-central region above the waterline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-contrast white clusters at the distal tips corresponding to barnacle colonization.
